title: Robotic Arm — 6-DOF
description: A 6-DOF robotic arm with full inverse kinematics, trajectory planning, and a custom BLDC controller.

blocks.content: Built a 6-DOF robotic arm from scratch using ROS2 and custom BLDC motor controllers. Implemented full inverse kinematics pipeline using analytical and numerical methods.

blocks.caption: Joint assembly — each joint uses a custom planetary gearbox

blocks.content: Trajectory planning with MoveIt2 — smooth interpolation across joint space. Custom PCB for motor driver with CAN bus communication between joints.

blocks.caption: Pick and place demo — 0.5kg payload at full reach

blocks.content: End-effector: 3-finger gripper with force feedback via strain gauges.
